card.name: Marrow and organ nouns after modifiers
card.fires_on: The noun right after a modifier, most often "marrow" after "bone" or "red", and sometimes "organs" or "ice". It appears in medical and science text.

modes.label: Bone marrow
modes.description: The word marrow after bone, red, or in marrow suppression and cellularity.

modes.label: Other body or science nouns

card.plain: It lights up on the word marrow in bone marrow, and occasionally on similar nouns like organs.
